title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 11
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q101_find_liable
elements.title: The court found the company liable for the damage. What did the court decide?
choices: The company had already paid all its bills.
The company was free of any responsibility.
The company owned the damaged building.

elements.name: q102_reshape
elements.title: The new rail line could ___ the city by changing where people live and work.

elements.name: q103_imbalance
elements.title: One team had twice as many players as the other, creating an ___.

elements.name: q104_flashing_red
elements.title: When an analyst says several indicators are “flashing red”, what are those indicators doing?
choices: Showing that data collection has finished

elements.name: q105_swing
elements.title: Public opinion can ___ sharply from support to opposition after a major announcement.

elements.name: q106_ransack
elements.title: The intruder ___ the room looking for the keys, leaving drawers overturned and papers scattered.

elements.name: q107_grapple_with
elements.title: The researchers are still trying to ___ a difficult question about why the results differed.

elements.name: q108_exile
elements.title: The writer became an ___ after being forced to leave his country for political reasons.

elements.name: q109_send_mixed_messages
elements.title: By urging staff to rest but praising them for working late, the manager sent ___.

elements.name: q110_centre_stage
elements.title: The transport dispute took ___ at the meeting, while other topics received little attention.
